brief: Global news today covers geopolitical tensions from West Africa to the Falklands, domestic political shifts in Germany and the US, and notable scientific advances in medical research. Papers highlight progress in black-box AI attacks, drug synergy prediction, and protein structure analysis.
news_summary: International stories include Russian involvement in Niger, far-right gains in Germany, and escalating US-Canada trade tensions. Domestically, legal battles over mail-in voting and military press freedom unfold, while a UN map vote sees the US isolated. The Tate brothers face new charges, and Bolivia mourns after a barracks explosion.
papers_summary: Research papers focus on cybersecurity (black-box attacks on semantic segmentation), biomedical breakthroughs (drug synergy, gephyrin clustering, AlphaFold 3 for amyloids), and visualization tools for genomics. Notable is the failure of heart drug pelacarsen, underscoring challenges in clinical trials.
